subject: [PATCH v4 04/11] mm, swap: support physical swap as a vswap backend

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch adds support for physical swap as a backend for the virtual swap layer, allowing zswap to decline pages and allocate physical slots on demand. The physical slot is tracked via a pointer-tagged swap_table entry, and readahead scans are modified to skip these entries. The patch also includes changes to handle failed reads of vswap entries and to bypass vswap when zswap is disabled at the host level or for the folio's cgroup.
